about.title: About
about.name: Gastón Varela
about.currentStatus: Information Technology Analyst, graduated from ORT Uruguay.
about.p1: I graduated as an IT Analyst from ORT in Montevideo. Most days I work full-stack: React and Next.js on the front, .NET or Node on the back, Docker when something has to stay up.
about.p2: Lately I've built tools for a pastry shop, a barbershop, and a construction company. At home I keep a small server running a couple of my own apps.
about.p3: Spanish is my first language. English is certified — EF SET, if you want the paper.

projects.title: Work
projects.subtitle: Client and company projects, from the frontend up through deploy.

blimann.title: Buildtracker
blimann.description:
Management system for a construction company. 
I built the frontend from the ground up, choosing the tech stack, designing components, architecture, folder hierarchy, style, design, and authentication system.
Implemented specific backend features and fixes. 
Adjusted and updated Docker images and CI/CD, added infrastructure.
blimann.stack: NextJS, TailwindCSS, Shadcn, Material UI, TypeScript, .NET, AWS, Terraform

horizon.title: Horizon
horizon.description:
Internal management system. 
Project where I inherited the frontend and performed UI/UX improvements across all pages, overall fixes, and added a complete filtering and searching feature that doubled query speeds. 
Rethought and reimplemented the desk reservation system, making it office-agnostic, applicable to any office, among other additions.

simois.title: Barberias Simois
simois.description:
Management system for a barber shop business.
Implemented comprehensive management of appointments, clients, branches, barbers, stakeholders, products, services, discounts, and schedules, including operational control metrics.
Developed separate applications for clients and employees, tailored to distinct workflows and access requirements.

algorico.title: Algo Rico
algorico.description:
Mobile-first self-hosted management system for a pastry business.
Built end-to-end to replace a paper customer/order agenda: clients, conversation history with screenshot attachments, orders, recipes, ingredients, calendar (orders as events), tasks, and an action-oriented dashboard.
Self-hosted with Dockerized PostgreSQL and MinIO for file storage.
algorico.stack: React, Vite, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, Zod, React Hook Form, Express, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, MinIO, Docker

ubuntu.title: Ubuntu Server Homelab
ubuntu.description: An Ubuntu server homelab where I manage multiple self-hosted applications—all dockerized—including Actual Budget for personal finance, Portainer for container operations, and a Minecraft server for gaming with friends. The host uses a fixed private IP on my LAN so services stay reachable reliably inside the network.
ubuntu.stack: Ubuntu Server, Docker, Docker Compose, Portainer, Actual Budget, Minecraft

scheduly.title: Scheduly
scheduly.description:
Mobile-first self-hosted tutor management app for university students in Uruguay.
Manages students, subjects, classes, payment status (paid/pending/free), balances, and an interactive calendar with drag-and-drop rescheduling on desktop.
Self-hosted with Dockerized PostgreSQL and cookie-based session auth.
scheduly.stack: React, Vite, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, Zod, React Hook Form, react-big-calendar, Express, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, Docker
